line: Say the thing, nicely. Staying quiet costs more today.
Your good mood is contagious today. Spread it in the group chat.
Someone will eye your seat today. Stand your ground, politely.
Team effort day. Just don't turn the group chat into a competition.
Learning sticks today. Read the thing you saved three weeks ago.
You want alone time today. Allowed. Reply to messages later.
Your reputation goes up today. Don't spend it all on one hot take.
Tough conversation day. Keep it short, kind and done.
Practical beats exciting today. Pick the reliable option.
Someone new could be useful today. Save their number, skip the impulse buy.
